en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

text.m: Ni zan karanta haruffan, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ka saurara.
text.f: Ni zan karanta haruffan, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ki saurara.

en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

text: Ga abin da zan faɗa:
en: Here is what I'll say:

text.m: Yanzu kai. Ka gwada.
text.f: Yanzu ke. Ki gwada.

en: Your turn. Try it.

text.m: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonka.
text.f: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonki.

en: My name is Laila. I am your learning friend.

text: Tare, za mu koyi Turanci.
en: Together we are going to learn English.

text: Ina da darussa masu kyau.
en: I have amazing lessons.

text: Za mu koyi haruffan Turanci.
en: We will learn the English alphabet.

text: Za mu koyi karatu da rubutu da Turanci.
en: We will learn to read and write in English.

text: Za mu koyi ƙirga.
en: We will learn to count.

text: Za mu koyi sunayen abubuwa kamar dabbobi da abinci da Turanci.
en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

text: Da sauran abubuwa masu ban sha'awa da yawa.
en: And many other amazing things.

text.m: Za ka iya magana da ni. Zan kasance tare da kai.
text.f: Za ki iya magana da ni. Zan kasance tare da ke.

en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

text.m: Na yi farin cikin ganinka.
text.f: Na yi farin cikin ganinki.

en: I am happy to see you.

text: Yanzu, mu ci gaba daga inda muka tsaya.
en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka faɗa da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka ce:
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki faɗa da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki ce:

en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say:

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka karanta da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka karanta kalmar:
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki karanta da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki karanta kalmar:

en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Laila, then you will read the word:

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka rubuta da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka faɗi haruffan:
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki rubuta da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki faɗi haruffan:

en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say the letters:

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi. Ka saurara, sannan ka danna hoton da aka faɗa.
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi. Ki saurara, sannan ki danna hoton da aka faɗa.

en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

text.m: Ga abin da za ka yi. Ka saurara, sannan ka danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.
text.f: Ga abin da za ki yi. Ki saurara, sannan ki danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.

en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

text.m: Yanzu, za a nuna maka hotuna huɗu. Ka saurara sunan da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ka danna shi.
text.f: Yanzu, za a nuna miki hotuna huɗu. Ki saurara sunan da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ki danna shi.

en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

text.m: Yanzu, za a nuna maka alamomi. Ka saurara lambar da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ka danna ta.
text.f: Yanzu, za a nuna miki alamomi. Ki saurara lambar da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ki danna ta.

en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

text: Za mu faɗi haruffan ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.
en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

text: Ta farko, da murya.
en: The first, with your voice.

text: Ta biyu, da allo.
en: The second, with the board.

text: Harafi na farko, zan faɗa da murya.
en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

text: Harafi na biyu ma, zan faɗa da murya.
en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

text: Harafi na ƙarshe kuwa, zan danna shi a kan allo.
en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

text.m: Ga balan-balan masu haruffa. Ka danna balan-balan da yatsanka, sai ya fashe.
text.f: Ga balan-balan masu haruffa. Ki danna balan-balan da yatsanki, sai ya fashe.

en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

text: Madalla, mun gama wasan!
en: Well done, we've finished the game!

text.m: Ka nemo harafi na farko na Turanci, ka fasa shi. Sannan harafin bayan sa.
text.f: Ki nemo harafi na farko na Turanci, ki fasa shi. Sannan harafin bayan sa.

en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it.

text.m: Ka fasa harafin farko:
text.f: Ki fasa harafin farko:

en: Pop the first letter:

text.m: Ka fasa harafi na gaba.
text.f: Ki fasa harafi na gaba.

en: Pop the next letter.

text.m: Zan sake nuna maka. Ka kula.
text.f: Zan sake nuna miki. Ki kula.

en: I will show you again. Pay attention.

text.m: Ba haka ba. Amma za ka gane nan da nan.
text.f: Ba haka ba. Amma za ki gane nan da nan.

en: That was not right, but you will learn.

text: Lokaci ya ƙare. Mu koyi haruffa tukuna.
en: Time is up. Let us learn the letters first.

text.m: Kada ka damu. Mu koyi su tukuna.
text.f: Kada ki damu. Mu koyi su tukuna.

en: Don't worry. Let us learn them first.

text: Za mu yi ɗan wasa.
en: We are going to play a little game.

text.m: Idan kana so ka koma gida, ka danna littafin.
text.f: Idan kina so ki koma gida, ki danna littafin.

en: To go home, press the book.

text.m: Muna so mu tabbatar cewa ka iya haruffan Turanci, kamar
text.f: Muna so mu tabbatar cewa kin iya haruffan Turanci, kamar

en: We want to make sure you know the English letters, like

text.m: Idan ka sani, ka danna Laila mu fara.
text.f: Idan kin sani, ki danna Laila mu fara.

en: If you know them, tap Laila to begin.

text.m: Ba damuwa. Za mu koye su tare. Ka danna baƙin allo.
text.f: Ba damuwa. Za mu koye su tare. Ki danna baƙin allo.

en: If you don't, no problem, we will learn them together. Tap the black slate to begin learning.

text.m: Ka kama kifin da ke ɗauke da abin da na faɗa.
text.f: Ki kama kifin da ke ɗauke da abin da na faɗa.

en: Catch the fish carrying the thing I say.

text.m: Duba hoton nan. Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi sunansa da Turanci, sai in buga kalangu!
text.f: Duba hoton nan. Ki danna Laila, ki faɗi sunansa da Turanci, sai in buga kalangu!

en: Look at this picture. Tap Laila, say its name in English, and I will beat the drum!

text.m: Masu saye sun zo! Da sauri, ka ba kowane ɗaya abin da ya nema.
text.f: Masu saye sun zo! Da sauri, ki ba kowane ɗaya abin da ya nema.

en: The shoppers are here! Quickly give each one what they ask for.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke cikin kowane kwale-kwale, sannan ka danna wadda ta dace da hoton.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke cikin kowane kwale-kwale, sannan ki danna wadda ta dace da hoton.

en: Read the word in each canoe, then tap the one that matches the picture.

text.m: Bari mu gina kalma da tukwane. Ka danna haruffa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
text.f: Bari mu gina kalma da tukwane. Ki danna haruffa ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

en: Let's build a word with pots. Tap the letters one after another.

text.m: Mu gina gida kafin lokaci ya ƙare! Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane harafi bulo ne.
text.f: Mu gina gida kafin lokaci ya ƙare! Ki danna Laila, ki faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane harafi bulo ne.

en: Let's build the house before time runs out! Tap Laila and say the word's letters one by one. Every letter is a brick.

text: Ba damuwa! Mu fara koyo tare. Danna Laila don a ci gaba.
en: No problem! Let's start learning together. Tap Laila to continue.

text: Danna Laila don a ci gaba.
en: Tap Laila to continue.

text.m: Ka faɗi harafin da ke kan tutar mahayin doki, sai ya gaida sarki!
text.f: Ki faɗi harafin da ke kan tutar mahayin doki, sai ya gaida sarki!

en: Say the letter on the horseman's banner, and he will greet the emir!

text.m: Ga yadda ake wasan: ka faɗi harafin da ka gani a kan tutar mahayin doki, domin Sarki ya yi murna.
text.f: Ga yadda ake wasan: ki faɗi harafin da kika gani a kan tutar mahayin doki, domin Sarki ya yi murna.

en: Here is how the game works: say the letter you see on the horseman's flag, so the Sarki is happy.

text.m: Yanzu, ka danna Laila mu fara.
text.f: Yanzu, ki danna Laila mu fara.

en: Now, press Laila and we will start.

text.m: Ka faɗi sunan abin nan da Turanci, sai dillali ya sayar da shi!
text.f: Ki faɗi sunan abin nan da Turanci, sai dillali ya sayar da shi!

en: Say this thing's name in English, and the auctioneer will sell it!

text.m: Ka faɗi abin da kake so da Turanci. Mai shayi zai miƙa maka!
text.f: Ki faɗi abin da kike so da Turanci. Mai shayi zai miƙa miki!

en: Say what you want in English, and the tea seller will give it to you!

text.m: Ka danna tarin buhu da yawansu ya yi daidai da lambar da na faɗa.
text.f: Ki danna tarin buhu da yawansu ya yi daidai da lambar da na faɗa.

en: Tap the stack with as many sacks as the number I say.

text.m: Ka danna dabbar da farashinta ya yi daidai da abin da na faɗa.
text.f: Ki danna dabbar da farashinta ya yi daidai da abin da na faɗa.

en: Tap the animal whose price matches what I say.

text.m: Ka ƙirga shanun da ke cikin garke, ka faɗi yawansu da Turanci.
text.f: Ki ƙirga shanun da ke cikin garke, ki faɗi yawansu da Turanci.

en: Count the cows in the pen and say how many in English.

text.m: Ga yadda ake wasan: ka ƙirga shanun da ke cikin garke, sai ka faɗi yawansu da Turanci.
text.f: Ga yadda ake wasan: ki ƙirga shanun da ke cikin garke, sai ki faɗi yawansu da Turanci.

en: Here is how the game works: count the cows in the pen, then say how many in English.

text.m: Ka faɗi kuɗin da ke hannunka da Turanci, sai ka biya mai suya.
text.f: Ki faɗi kuɗin da ke hannunki da Turanci, sai ki biya mai suya.

en: Say the money in your hand in English, and pay the suya seller.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke kan allo da ƙarfi, sai mu wanke shi.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke kan allo da ƙarfi, sai mu wanke shi.

en: Read the word on the board out loud, and we will wash it clean.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke kan jirgin ruwa da ƙarfi. Jirgin zai zo bakin ruwa.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke kan jirgin ruwa da ƙarfi. Jirgin zai zo bakin ruwa.

en: Read the word on the boat out loud, and it will come to the bank.

text.m: Ka faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ko kuma ka danna su a kan allo. Sai marubuci ya rubuta su.
text.f: Ki faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ko kuma ki danna su a kan allo. Sai marubuci ya rubuta su.

en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the letter writer will write them.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke kan girgije da ƙarfi, domin a yi ruwan sama a gona.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke kan girgije da ƙarfi, domin a yi ruwan sama a gona.

en: Read the word on the cloud out loud, and the rain will fall on the farm.

text.m: Ka faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ko ka danna su a kan allo. Sai mai rini ya rina zanen.
text.f: Ki faɗi haruffan kalmar ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ko ki danna su a kan allo. Sai mai rini ya rina zanen.

en: Say the letters of the word one by one, or press them on the keyboard, and the dyer will dye the cloth.

text.m: Yanzu mu yi wasa da haruffan da ka koya!
text.f: Yanzu mu yi wasa da haruffan da kika koya!

en: Now let's play a game with the letters you've learned!

text.m: Kaa kusa. Mu sake gwadawa sau ɗaya.
text.f: Kin kusa. Mu sake gwadawa sau ɗaya.

en: You were close! Let's try once more.

text.m: Yanzu za ka iya buga wannan wasan a duk lokacin da kake so, daga shafin farko.
text.f: Yanzu za ki iya buga wannan wasan a duk lokacin da kike so, daga shafin farko.

en: Now you can play this game whenever you like, from the home page.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari uku da zinari hamsin.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari uku da zinari hamsin.

en: Well done! You earned three stars and 50 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari uku da zinari ɗari.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari uku da zinari ɗari.

en: Well done! You earned three stars and 100 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari uku da zinari ɗari da hamsin.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari uku da zinari ɗari da hamsin.

en: Well done! You earned three stars and 150 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari uku da zinari ɗari biyu.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari uku da zinari ɗari biyu.

en: Well done! You earned three stars and 200 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari huɗu da zinari hamsin.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari huɗu da zinari hamsin.

en: Well done! You earned four stars and 50 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari huɗu da zinari ɗari.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari huɗu da zinari ɗari.

en: Well done! You earned four stars and 100 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari huɗu da zinari ɗari da hamsin.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari huɗu da zinari ɗari da hamsin.

en: Well done! You earned four stars and 150 gold.

text.m: Madalla! Ka samu taurari huɗu da zinari ɗari biyu.
text.f: Madalla! Kin samu taurari huɗu da zinari ɗari biyu.

en: Well done! You earned four stars and 200 gold.

text.m: Yanzu kai Jarumi ne!
text.f: Yanzu ke Jaruma ce!

en: Now you are a Jarumi / Jaruma!

text.m: Yanzu kai Malami ne!
text.f: Yanzu ke Malama ce!

en: Now you are a Malami / Malama!

text.m: Yanzu kai Ɗan Sarki ne!
text.f: Yanzu ke 'Yar Sarki ce!

en: Now you are a Ɗan Sarki / 'Yar Sarki!

text.m: Yanzu kai Magaji ne!
text.f: Yanzu ke Magajiya ce!

en: Now you are a Magaji / Magajiya!

text.m: Yanzu kai Sarki ne!
text.f: Yanzu ke Sarauniya ce!

en: Now you are a Sarki / Sarauniya!

text.m: Ƙoƙarinka ya kai ka sabon matsayi!
text.f: Ƙoƙarinki ya kai ki sabon matsayi!

en: Your effort has brought you to a new level!

text.m: Buhunka na farko na zinari ya cika!
text.f: Buhunki na farko na zinari ya cika!

en: Your first bag of gold is full!

text.m: Buhunka na biyu na zinari ya cika!
text.f: Buhunki na biyu na zinari ya cika!

en: Your second bag of gold is full!

text.m: Buhunka na uku na zinari ya cika!
text.f: Buhunki na uku na zinari ya cika!

en: Your third bag of gold is full!

text.m: Buhunka na huɗu na zinari ya cika!
text.f: Buhunki na huɗu na zinari ya cika!

en: Your fourth bag of gold is full!

text.m: Buhunka na biyar na zinari ya cika!
text.f: Buhunki na biyar na zinari ya cika!

en: Your fifth bag of gold is full!

text.m: Zinarinka ya kai dubu ɗaya.
text.f: Zinarinki ya kai dubu ɗaya.

en: Your Zinari have reached 1,000.

text.m: Zinarinka ya kai dubu biyu.
text.f: Zinarinki ya kai dubu biyu.

en: Your Zinari have reached 2,000.

text.m: Zinarinka ya kai dubu huɗu.
text.f: Zinarinki ya kai dubu huɗu.

en: Your Zinari have reached 4,000.

text.m: Zinarinka ya kai dubu shida.
text.f: Zinarinki ya kai dubu shida.

en: Your Zinari have reached 6,000.

text.m: Zinarinka ya kai dubu goma.
text.f: Zinarinki ya kai dubu goma.

en: Your Zinari have reached 10,000.

text: Wannan shi ne matsayi na farko. Akwai ƙarin matsayi guda huɗu a gaba.
en: This is the first level. There are four more levels ahead.

text.m: Ci gaba da ƙoƙari, har ka zama Sarki!
text.f: Ci gaba da ƙoƙari, har ki zama Sarauniya!

en: Keep trying, until you become Sarki / Sarauniya!

text: Ci gaba da ƙoƙari haka!
en: Keep up the effort like this!

text: Wannan shi ne matsayi mafi girma duka!
en: This is the highest level of all!

text: Ci gaba da karatu kullum!
en: Keep learning every day!

text.m: Mahayan Sallah suna zuwa! Ka faɗi harafin da ke kan tutar kowane mahayin doki.
text.f: Mahayan Sallah suna zuwa! Ki faɗi harafin da ke kan tutar kowane mahayin doki.

en: The Sallah riders are coming! Say each letter as its horseman rides past.

text.m: Haruffa suna tashi a cikin balan-balan. Ka fasa harafin da na faɗa.
text.f: Haruffa suna tashi a cikin balan-balan. Ki fasa harafin da na faɗa.

en: Letters float up in balloons. Pop the letter Laila says.

text.m: Ka taimaki matar kasuwa: ka yi sauri ka nemo abincin da na faɗa.
text.f: Ki taimaki matar kasuwa: ki yi sauri ki nemo abincin da na faɗa.

en: Help the market woman: quickly find the food Laila names.

text.m: Mu je kamun kifi! Ka kama kifin da ke ɗauke da hoton da ya dace.
text.f: Mu je kamun kifi! Ki kama kifin da ke ɗauke da hoton da ya dace.

en: Go fishing: catch the fish that carries the right picture.

text.m: Idan ka ji kalmar da ta dace, ka buga kalangu.
text.f: Idan kin ji kalmar da ta dace, ki buga kalangu.

en: Beat the drum when you hear the right word.

text.m: Kai ne mai shayi. Ka bai wa kowane mai saye abin da ya nema.
text.f: Ke ce mai shayi. Ki bai wa kowane mai saye abin da ya nema.

en: Run the tea stall: serve each customer the thing they ask for.

text.m: Kai ne dillali: ka faɗi sunan kowane abu domin ka sayar da shi.
text.f: Ke ce dillaliya: ki faɗi sunan kowane abu domin ki sayar da shi.

en: Be the auctioneer: say the name of each thing to sell it.

text.m: Ka loda buhun gyaɗa a babbar mota. Sannan ka ƙirga su.
text.f: Ki loda buhun gyaɗa a babbar mota. Sannan ki ƙirga su.

en: Load the groundnut sacks onto the lorry and count them.

text.m: Ka sayar da suya a kasuwar dare, ka ƙirga kuɗin.
text.f: Ki sayar da suya a kasuwar dare, ki ƙirga kuɗin.

en: Sell suya at the night market and count the money.

text.m: Ka karanta wa ajin kalmar da ke kan allo.
text.f: Ki karanta wa ajin kalmar da ke kan allo.

en: Read the word on the allo board to the class.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke kan kowane jirgin ruwa domin ya tafi.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke kan kowane jirgin ruwa domin ya tafi.

en: Read the word on each boat to let it sail.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar. Sai kwale-kwale ya tsallaka kogi.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar. Sai kwale-kwale ya tsallaka kogi.

en: Read the word on the canoe to paddle across the river.

text.m: Ka karanta kalmar da ke kan girgijen hadari, sai ruwan sama ya sa gero ya girma.
text.f: Ki karanta kalmar da ke kan girgijen hadari, sai ruwan sama ya sa gero ya girma.

en: Read the word on the storm cloud so the rain makes the millet grow.

text.m: Ka rubuta kalmar da tukwanen haruffa.
text.f: Ki rubuta kalmar da tukwanen haruffa.

en: Spell the word with the letter pots.

text.m: Ka rubuta kalmar bulo bayan bulo domin ka gina katanga.
text.f: Ki rubuta kalmar bulo bayan bulo domin ki gina katanga.

en: Spell the word brick by brick to build the wall.

text.m: Ka taimaki marubucin wasiƙa. Ka rubuta kalmar.
text.f: Ki taimaki marubucin wasiƙa. Ki rubuta kalmar.

en: Help the letter writer spell the word on the envelope.

text.m: Ka rubuta kalmar da zanen rini na Kano.
text.f: Ki rubuta kalmar da zanen rini na Kano.

en: Spell the word by dyeing each letter cloth in the Kano dye pits.

text.m: Ka nemo saniyar da farashinta ya dace a kasuwar shanu.
text.f: Ki nemo saniyar da farashinta ya dace a kasuwar shanu.

en: Find the cow with the right price at the cattle market.

text.m: Ka ƙirga shanun yayin da suke shiga garke.
text.f: Ki ƙirga shanun yayin da suke shiga garke.

en: Count the cattle as they go into the kraal.

text.m: Taurari suna jira! Ka danna su bisa tsari, daga ɗaya.
text.f: Taurari suna jira! Ki danna su bisa tsari, daga ɗaya.

en: The stars are waiting! Press them in order, from one.
